description: Holds weakly planner details records, linked to client, weakly planner headers.
business_purpose: Used to track and report weakly planner details records, including amounts and quantities, for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one weakly planner detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: WeaklyPlannerHeaderid
columns.description: Reference to the weakly planner headers linked to this weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencerId
columns.description: Reference to the client linked to this weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_ply_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Influencer ply sheet supplied of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_pvc_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Influencer pvc sheet supplied of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_total_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Influencer total sheet supplied of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_ply_sheet_planned
columns.description: Influencer ply sheet planned of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_pvc_sheet_planned
columns.description: Influencer pvc sheet planned of the weakly planner detail.

columns.name: influencer_total_sheet_planned
columns.description: Influencer total sheet planned of the weakly planner detail.

relationships.description: Each weakly planner detail references one weakly planner headers (weakly planner header).
Each weakly planner detail references one client (influencer).

business_rules: Use influencer_total_sheet_supplied / influencer_total_sheet_planned for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Client, Weakly Planner Headers through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Influencer Total Sheet Supplied per weakly planner detail

common_queries: Weakly Planner Details by weakly planner headers
Top weakly planner headers by influencer total sheet supplied

known_issues: influencer_total_sheet_supplied, influencer_total_sheet_planned are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name weaklyPlannerDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting weakly planner detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(influencer_total_sheet_supplied) for totals of influencer total sheet supplied.
To resolve names, join on: WeaklyPlannerHeaderid = weaklyPlannerHeaders.id; influencerId = Client.Id.
